name: ParkingTicket
description: Stores parking ticket information including violation details, vehicle data, and payment status

fields.name: ticketNumber
fields.description: Unique ticket identifier

fields.name: licensePlate
fields.description: Vehicle license plate number

fields.name: violationType
fields.description: Type of parking violation (e.g., expired meter, no parking zone)

fields.name: fineAmount
fields.description: Fine amount in dollars

fields.name: issuedAt
fields.description: Date and time when ticket was issued

fields.name: location
fields.description: Street address or location where violation occurred

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current ticket status (issued, paid, appealed, dismissed)

fields.name: officerId
fields.description: ID of officer who issued the ticket

name: User
description: Store user profiles for parking officers, administrators, and violators with authentication and role-based access

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the user

fields.name: email
fields.description: User's email address for authentication and communication

fields.name: role
fields.description: User role: officer, admin, or violator

fields.name: fullName
fields.description: User's full legal name

fields.name: phoneNumber
fields.description: Contact phone number

fields.name: badgeNumber
fields.description: Badge number for parking officers (null for other roles)

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Whether the user account is active

fields.name: lastLoginAt
fields.description: Timestamp of the user's last login

constraints.role: Must be one of: officer, admin, violator
constraints.badgeNumber: Required for officers, null for other roles

name: Payment
description: Records payment transactions for parking tickets including amount, method, status, and confirmation details

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the payment transaction

fields.name: ticketId
fields.description: Reference to the associated parking ticket

fields.name: amount
fields.description: Payment amount in currency units

fields.name: paymentMethod
fields.description: Method of payment (credit_card, debit_card, cash, check, online)

fields.name: transactionDate
fields.description: Date and time when the payment was processed

fields.name: status
fields.description: Payment status (completed, pending, failed, refunded)

fields.name: confirmationNumber
fields.description: Unique confirmation number for the payment transaction

fields.name: userId
fields.description: Reference to the user who made the payment

relationships.description: Each payment is associated with one parking ticket
Each payment is made by one user

constraints.paymentMethod: Must be one of: credit_card, debit_card, cash, check, online
constraints.status: Must be one of: completed, pending, failed, refunded

name: Appeal
description: Manages ticket appeals and dispute resolution process for parking tickets

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the appeal

fields.name: ticketId
fields.description: Reference to the parking ticket being appealed

fields.name: reason
fields.description: Detailed explanation for the appeal submission

fields.name: submissionDate
fields.description: Date and time when the appeal was submitted

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current review status (pending, under_review, approved, denied)

fields.name: decisionOutcome
fields.description: Final decision on the appeal (approved, denied, partially_approved)

fields.name: reviewerNotes
fields.description: Notes and comments from the reviewer regarding the decision

fields.name: decisionDate
fields.description: Date when the final decision was made

relationships.description: Each appeal is associated with one parking ticket
